title: Writing a Linear Model
body: A phone company has a monthly cellular data plan where a customer pays a flat monthly fee of $10 and then a certain amount of money per megabyte (MB) of data used on the phone. If a customer uses $$20$$ MB, the monthly cost will be $$\$11.20$$. If the customer uses $$130$$ MB, the monthly cost will be $$\$17.80$$.
